run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the googlemock group CC'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom --cc flags to add extra reviewers alongside the googlemock group
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-adds the googlemock mailing list to CC
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py wrapper script that passes CLI args to upload.py with an added CC flag
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the googlemock group
